method: Organization contributors (business, PAC/committee, other) in campaign.json were compared with vendor names in data/contracts/contracts.json (contracts, change_orders, emergency_purchases, and check-register top_vendors). Names were normalized (lowercase; punctuation, "&"/"and", and suffixes such as Inc, LLC, Co, Corp, PA removed) and each candidate pair was reviewed by hand. "exact" = normalized names are identical; "likely" = the same name with an abbreviation, truncation or misspelling in the filing. One row per contributor, candidate and contracting government. A match shows only that an organization with the same name appears in both public records.
